content: Tantiti neten bero pibonahibo
Jaatian sca tantiti neten sca bahin cahax trigo huai nabebacahini cahi. Hahbetan caquin, jahuen haxenicabaan huestibo bero tesabonaxon, bishqui bishquihahxon xocaxon picanquin.
Jascajahiton fariseobaan jato yocaquin: —¿Jahua copi man jascajahin, tantiti neten non piti tsinquitimahi bi? —hahcanquin.
Jesusen sca jato yohiquin: —¿Papan joi jisquin man Davidinin hahní honanyamahin? Hahbetan cahibo picatsihquiya jaa rihbi picatsihquish,

Papan xobo janin hihcoxon Papa jismanoxon pejanxonti paan hinanah bihxon, pixon, hahbe nichibo rihbi jan hinanni man honanyamahin? Jascapa ta tsoanbi pitimahiqui, Papa yohixonnica huestichin ta jaa piti hahtipahiqui —hahquin Jesusen.
Sirijaquin yohiquin sca jato yohirihbiquin: —Hea ta hen noquebaque qui, tantiti nete hihbo —jato jaquin.
Meyosmahi
Huetsa tantiti neten rihbi sca jaton tsinquiti xoboho mapexon jato haxemaribiquin. Huesti meyosma joni rihbi jano tsahoti, mecayaho jahuen mequen yosmahi.
Tantiti neten ta rahonnicabaan tsoabi rahontimahihqui, tantiti netenbi jaa rohajatihiquin hihxon ta jaton haxemanicahbo betan fariseobaan jisisnishqui. Hahan cahenoxon jisiscanquin.
Jahua yohuan jaabo rahsi jaiquin jahuen jointinin honanxon ta jaton nincanonbi meyosma joni sca yohinishqui: —Huenihihnatax naponbi nihhue —hahquin. Jascajaha huenihihnatax jato tocanbi nihrenenscai.

Reren rerenaibo sca Jesusen yocaquin: —¿Tantiti neten non siribojaxontimahin? ¿Tantiti neten non tiromajatihin? ¿Joni huetsa non tantiti neten jihuematihin? ¿Non mahuamatihin? Hea yohinahue —hahquin Jesusen.
Jato jispaquexon meyosma sca yohiquin: —Miin mequen sanahihnihue —hahquin. Yohihah mehanscaax rohacahinscai.
Roha sca jaa jai bi jano tsahotaibo sina sinati. Jesus qui yohuan yohuanscacani, jahueja non jaa jatihin, hihqui.
Doce haxenicabo Jesusen caisai
Jascaripish noquen Papa yohihi sca mahchi manichi Jesus cahi. Yametai bi janoxonbi Papa Dios yoca yocashinaquin.
Xabacoscaiya cahen jahuen haxenicabo quenascaquin. Hahqui jahuiton doce res caisxon: —Mato tah man heen raantibo qui —hahquin.
Jan caisni ta neabo qui: Simon, jahuen jane huetsa cahen Pedro. Jahuen huetsa Andres rihbi, Jacoboya Juan jaabo rabe rihbi, Felipe, Bartolomé.
Mateo, Tomas, Santiago Alfeon baque, Simon Zelotes hahcaibo
Judas Santiagonen baque, Judas Iscariote, jaabo rahsi. Judas Iscariote cahen Jesus paranxon judiobo
Hicha jonibo Jesusen haxemahi

Jato betan botoquihrani jahuex sca mai mispani janin nihrenenai bi hicha haxehibo becani. Nincaqui becani, hihti caibo. Jaabo cahen Judea mai mehax behibo, Jerusalen janinhax behibo. Tiro jema janinhahbo, Sidon jema janinhahbo, quebijistima hian quexa jihuetaibo.
Jesus nincacatsihqui jahuibo, rahomehti jahuibo. Caibo rihbi tiroma yoshinbaan hihbojani bi becani. Jascapahbo rihbi ta Jesusen rohajanishqui.
Jesus mehehax jahuen coshin rohahibo rahsibo quen jano jaibo rahsichin jaa mehecatsihscacani.
Hahan jenimatiboya hahan benatibo
Jato honanmaxon bejisquin sca jato yohiquin: Jenimanahue jahuaborajomabon. Papan ta mato jihuematihiqui. Mato cah man jahuen jihuetahbo.
Jenimanahue pihan hihquibon. Man tah man yaniyaxihqui, rohahihrichi. Jenimanahue huinihibon. Man tah man coin coini bitsayaxihqui.
Jonibaan mato jistahihmaha jenimanahue. Mato yohuanquihnyamascaxon bi mato roa roahahbo bi jenimanahue. Man hea nincacoinai copi maton janeya tiromahi yohuanaiboya jenimarihbinahue.
Mato jascahibaan bi hihti coincoinnahue. Jaton xohtabaan ta Papan joi chaninicabo jascajaribinishqui. Naihoh sca ta janoxon mato hinantibo Papan mato hicha bexojaxonihqui. Jaa copi jenimanahue.
Jascapahbo hahan jenimati jaibo bi ta hicha coriquiyahpahax man ¡Hahrai! hihyaxihqui. Maton jahuaboraya jenimati shinanxon bi tah man jahuabi hashoan bihtimahi.
Rahma yanitax bi tah man Hahrai hihyaxihqui hihti pihaxmahhuan hihquish. Rahma bitsatax bi tah man Hahrai hihyaxihqui bena benatax huaohihquish.
Jatihibi jonibo mato qui siripi yohuanaiya Hahrai hihnahue. Papan joi yohihihcamahi quesahiboya ta maton papabo jato qui jascarihbihi siripi yohuanpahonishqui.
Rahuibohon non shinantihi
Mato tah hen yohihi, nincanahue. Maton rahuibohon shinannahue. Mato jistahihmahibaan bi jato sirijaquin hahxoncoinnahue.
Mato roahibaan bi jato qui Papa yocaxonnahue. Mato tahtijahibaan bi jato yocaxonnahue.
Mia copasah bi copixonma ramiqui sca jismahue. Miin coton mia bichincatsihquiya jaa hinanax miin camiseta rihbi yohuashihyamahue.
Mia yocacaibo jatihibi hinanhue. Mia bichinai bi bichinyamascahue.
Hea hahxoncanpahinon hih min jain, jato pari hahxonhue, min jato hahxonai quescajaribiquin mia hahxonnon.
Matohon queenaibohon tah man copinani queenai. ¿Jaa copi man shinanyahpabo hihqui man shinanain? Nincayosmabo rihbi ta jascanica qui, jatohon queenaibohon queeni copinani.
¿Caibaan rihbi mato siribojaxonah, copinanquin sca jato siribojaxonquin bi man jaa copi hicha shinanyahpabo man jihuetai man shinanain? Nincayosmabaan rihbi ta jascajanica qui.
¿Jan mato hinanrihbitihi honanxon man joni huetsa coriqui hinantahbax man jaa copi shinanyahpa sca jain? Nincayosmabaan rihbi ta hahbe nincayosmabo hinantahbahiqui, jatihibi bihribiyanoxon.

Jaabo jascahi bi tah man maton rahuibohon man shinantihi. Jascapahbo siribojaxonnahue. Hinantahxon bihribiti masa shinanyamanahue. Naihohxon sca ta Papan mato hinanrihbiyaxihquiqui, hashoan hicha sca. Bihribiti shinanxonma hinantahbax tah man noquen naihoh queha Papan baquebo jihuetihi. Jaan rihbi ta jahuen sinatahbohon shinanihqui, jahuen tiromabohon bi shinanquin.
Yomanahtaibohon shinannahue, maton naihoh queha Papan hahcai quescajaquin. Hohmis hohmisaibohon bi maton naihoh queha Papan jatohon shinanquin hahcai quescajarihbinahue.
Joni huetsa qui tiromahi yohuantima

Min hahcai quescajayamaquin bi jaan hahcai quescajaquin joni huetsan jahuaborajahi jisish, Jahuejanoxon jascajahiquin, tiroma joni tah qui hihyamanahue. Jaatian ta mato rihbi Papan jascajayamayaxihquiqui. Caibaan mato tiromajanih bi jaa tiromani shinanyamanahue, maton Papan rihbi man tiromani shinanyamanon.

Pishinaibo hinannahue, maton papan ta mato hinanrihbiyaxihquiqui. Yohuashihxonma ta tasa bochojaxon bishtaxpaquexon tsahonpaquexon shaconxon hahquirihbi matsanhihnixon mato hinanrihbiyaxihcanihqui. Hinannoxon man toponai quescabijaquin ta maton Papan mato hinanrihbiyaxihquiqui —hahquin Jesusen.
Jato jascajaxon jaa patax queha joi sca jato nincamaquin. Benchen ta hahbe benche bahi jismatimahiqui. Jismacatsihqui bi ta mai xanquen qui rabebi paquetihiqui.
Haxenica ta jahuen haxemanicah mentan hashoan honan hihyamahiqui. Sirijaquin haxemaha pari ta jahuen haxemanicah quesca sca jatihiqui.
¿Jenquetsahaxon min miin bero janin jihuihhuan jaxon bi miin huetsan bero qui jai poto pishca min yohitihin?

Miin bero janin jihui jaxon jenquetsahaxon sca min miin huetsa yohitihin, Miin bero janin jai poto pishca hean tsecanon tenehue huetsan, hah min jatihin? ¡Quesan! Miin bero qui jai jihui pari tah min potatihi. Jaatian pari tah min jisquin sirijaxon miin huetsa bejistihi, jahuen poto bero pishca tsecanoxon.
Bimibo jisxon non jihui honanai
Jihui siribo ta bimi tiromayahpa yamatihiqui. Jihui payo rihbi ta bimi siriboya jatimahiqui.
Jenquetsahpa jihui hin hihxon tah non jahuen bimi jisxon jatihibi jihui honanai. Moxayahpa jihui queha tah non pama tsinquitimahi. Moxayahpa yora quiha rihbi tah non xexon bihtimahi.

Noquen jointi janin siri shinanbo jaiya tah non siri yohuan noque jai. Jascarihbihi tah non tiroma jonihax noquen jointi janin tiroma shinanboya tiroma yohuan rihbi jai. Noquen jointi janin jai shinanboya tah non yohuanai.
Xobojahibo rabe
¿Hen jahuejanon hihxon man hea Hihbon Hihbon hahcain, hen mato yohihah hea nincaxonma bi hea quenaquin?
Hehqui joxon hen yohihi nincaxon jaabijaquin hahcaibo rahsi jenquetsahpabo hin hihxon tah hen mato yohihi.

Jascapa hihquish tah min xobojahi joni quesca qui. Xobo jihuibo nichinnoxon ta nincacoinnicaton nemin pari mai poquinihqui, minquex mai qui nocoxon xobo jihui nichinnoxon. Jaatian ta jenehhuan joxon mai mahpobahinxon bahiquin xobo bocatsihquin bi hahtipahyamahiqui, sirijaquin jan xobo jihui nichinai copi.

Hen yohihah nincaxon bi hahyamahi joni ta mashin xobojanoxon bemacanya poquinxon jihui nichinai quescapah qui. Jenehhuan joxon maimahah ta xobo paquerestihiqui, jenen huaxa huaxascanon —jato jaquin Jesusen.
